plan.summary: This 1-4 block starts the 12-week off-camp build for boxing with one focused full-body session each week. Week 1 is used to establish a baseline on the main squat pattern so later loading can be adjusted cleanly, and the main training work starts in Week 2. Because you only have one S&C session per week and want more conditioning, each session keeps the highest-value power and strength work first, then adds practical accessory work and a short conditioning finish without creating unnecessary soreness for boxing practice.

phaseOverview.label: Building
phaseOverview.focus: Build general lower-body power, basic full-body strength, and simple repeatable conditioning with beginner-friendly lifts.

phaseOverview.label: Intensifying
phaseOverview.focus: Progress the main strength work and keep power crisp while conditioning stays supportive and recoverable.

phaseOverview.label: Expressing
phaseOverview.focus: Shift more toward faster power and sharper outputs while holding onto the strength built earlier.
